events.title: 에버턴 win the Charity Shield by beating Merseyside rivals 리버풀 1–0 at Wembley . The only goal is inadvertently deflected into his own net by Reds' goalkeeper Bruce Grobbelaar .

The new league season has an early start as the London derby between 아스널 and 첼시 kicks off at 11:30am on police advice. The match ends in a 1–1 draw in front of over 45,000 at Highbury . Three penalties (one missed) and an own goal at Carrow Road where 노리치 시티 come from 2–0 and 3–2 down to hold champions 리버풀 to a 3–3 draw. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are pegged back by an 89th minute 왓퍼드 equaliser at Old Trafford . 에버턴 crash 4–1 at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼 for whom debutants Clive Allen and John Chiedozie are among the scorers. In the Second Division, newly promoted 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 win 3–0 at 허더즈필드 타운 but 윔블던 are held to a 2–2 draw by 맨체스터 시티 after leading 2–0. Biggest winners of the day are 엑서터 시티 who beat 노샘프턴 타운 5–0 in Division Four.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 애스턴 빌라 both have two wins from their opening two matches but 스토크 시티 and 에버턴 are still looking for their first points. Paul Walsh scores after 14 seconds of his home debut for 리버풀, a 3–0 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 .
에버턴 get off the mark with a 1–0 win at 첼시 who were previously unbeaten since January.
